messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert - billing/usage-metering ingestion lag detected. Pipeline "metering-ingest-v2" lag > 45m. Some customers are seeing stale/low usage on the dashboard and delayed invoice generation. Root ts: 1717459200

Sam K.: @incident-bot - confirming. Which ingestion cluster? any failures or just lag?

incident-bot: Affected: ingest-cluster-eu-1. Kafka consumer lag spiked. 403k messages behind. Error rate from transformer service ~2.3%.

Maya R. (on-call): I'm on-call for billing today — jumping in. :eyes: Starting triage. Can someone grab last successful offset and bad records sample?

Diego S.: Pulling offsets now. Quick check: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group metering-ingest-v2 --describe` shows lag on partition 7/8. Attaching snippet:
```
TOPIC               PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
metering-events      7          1245234         1768457         523223
```

Natalie (Billing): Support ticket volume about billing discrepancies already at ~12. CS flagged multiple customers asking "why is our usage lower than expected?"

Maya R.: Ok. Two-parallel plan: 1) short-term mitigation: spin up an extra consumer replica in eu-1 and temporarily increase parallelism; 2) start backfill job to reprocess missed offsets once consumer catches up. Sam, can you approve the scale-up? ETA ~ 12-18m to add pod + rebal.

Sam K.: Approved. Run `kubectl -n billing scale deployment/metering-ingest-v2 --replicas=6` and monitor. Keep me posted.

Diego S.: Scaling now. Logs show consumer restart thrashing initially (OOM on transformer). Increasing pod size and applying jvm flags. Command used:
```
kubectl patch deploy metering-transformer -n billing -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"transformer","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"8Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```

Maya R.: Patch applied. New pods coming up. Monitoring consumer lag.

(5m later)

Diego S.: Lag dropping: 523k -> 62k -> 8k. Transformer error rate down to 0.1%.

incident-bot: Incident timeline note: mitigation started at 1717459380. Current status: consumer lag decreasing. Recommend preparing status page message and a customer-facing note for impacted accounts.

Support Team: Drafting customer notice. Need approved language: short, non-technical, with remediation and credits if applicable. Suggest: "We're aware of a billing display issue affecting usage numbers and invoice timing for a subset of customers. We're actively replaying missed data; usage will be reconciled and invoices reissued where necessary. No charges will be applied incorrectly. Expected resolution window: 4–8 hours."

Sam K.: Change "No charges will be applied incorrectly" -> "We will not charge for data that was not processed; any corrections will be reflected on next invoice or an adjusted invoice as needed." Also include contact link to CS.

Maya R.: I will post a concise status page entry. Draft below — feedback welcome:

Status page draft:
```
Title: Partial delay in billing usage ingestion (EU region)
Status: Investigating -> Identified
Impact: Some customers may see reduced/lagged usage in dashboards or delayed invoices. No confirmed incorrect charges; reconciliation in progress.
Next update: in 1 hour
Mitigation: Increased consumer capacity and running backfill for missed events. Estimated full reconciliation within 4–8 hours.
```

Natalie (Billing): Add note about credits: "Customers who were invoiced incorrectly will receive an adjusted invoice or credit. CS will proactively reach out to affected accounts." Also list affected regions: EU only for now.

Katie (CS Lead): On it. Drafting targeted outbound for customers who opened tickets. Template:
```
Hi {customer_name},
We're investigating a temporary delay in usage reporting which may affect the numbers in your billing dashboard. We're reprocessing events and expect usage to be fully reconciled within 4–8 hours. Any invoice adjustments will be handled automatically; your account manager will follow up if manual action is required.

If you have urgent billing questions reply here and we'll prioritize.
Thanks, Katie
```

Maya R.: Also drafting internal comms for Sales/Finance:
```
Internal (short): Billing ingestion lag in eu-1 cluster caused dashboards to show stale usage and delayed invoice runs. Mitigation: scaled consumers and reprocessing. Expected reconciliation 4–8 hours. Finance: do not close billing runs until reconciliation done; hold auto-invoice tasks for affected customers.
Owner: Natalie (Billing). Postmortem: Maya + Natalie.
```

Sam K.: Action item: mark affected invoice runs in the billing system with tag `incident-1717459200` to avoid auto-send. Diego, can you add that to the backfill job? It's important otherwise automations will kick in.

Diego S.: Will add. Backfill job command (dry-run first):
```
python jobs/reprocess.py --topic metering-events --from-offset 1245234 --to-end --tag incident-1717459200 --dry-run
```

(20m later)

incident-bot: Consumer lag caught up to <500. Backfill job started at 1717460400. Monitoring reprocessed message throughput (~12k/s). Keep tracking errors and reconcile counts.

Maya R.: Reprocess throughput steady. Starting quick reconciliation query to verify totals for sample customer ACME-Corp. SQL to compare dashboard vs raw events:
```
SELECT account_id, count(*) as raw_events FROM metering_events
WHERE timestamp >= '2026-03-14'::date
AND account_id = 'ACME-Corp'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

Support Team: ACME-Corp ticket updated with ETA and internal note.

Sam K.: Good. Next: prepare a short status update for the status page (confirmed) with ETA and link to support article. Maya, send the posted text and I'll approve.

Maya R.: Posting now. Status page update posted: "Identified - We have increased processing capacity and started reprocessing missed events. Dashboards and invoices will be reconciled within 4–8 hours."

(handoff, 1h 20m after incident start)

Maya R.: I'm handing off active monitoring to Diego for overnight. Diego, please watch reprocess throughput and error rate. If error > 1% or backlog reappears, page oncall -> @pagerduty. I'll follow up first thing tomorrow for postmortem notes.

Diego S.: Acknowledged. I'll keep an eye and escalate as needed. Setting alert thresholds and a 30m check-in cadence.

Natalie (Billing): I'll own customer reconciliation and invoice adjustments after reprocess completes. Preparing reconciliation runbook and credit policy notes.

Katie (CS Lead): CS will proactively message high-touch customers and prioritize tickets. Tagging tickets with `incident-1717459200`.

Sam K.: Postmortem owner: Natalie. Please include timeline, root cause (consumer memory/OOM + transformer error causing slowdowns), mitigation steps, and actions: (1) increase default transformer memory/oom guard, (2) autoscale consumer faster, (3) improve alerting for lag thresholds.

incident-bot: Incident moved to "monitoring" at 1717462800. Final note: customer-facing update and internal comms drafted; owners assigned. Closing thread for live coordination — continue monitoring in this channel and update last_message_ts when there's notable change.

Diego S.: :white_check_mark: I'll update if anything changes. Last check - reprocess at 97% complete.

Katie (CS Lead): Ticket and CS outbound queued. Thanks team. :memo:

-- end of thread --
